items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I’ll be doing some dates in England with Harry Allen. He and I and a rhythm section. ... we’re going to be making a CD while we’re there

ctx.x: I’m going by myself. I’ll be doing some dates in England with Harry Allen. He and I and a rhythm section. In fact, I think we’re going to be making a CD while we’re there for Nagal-Hayer records, it’s a German company and they’re doing quite well. And as I say I’ll finish up in Vienna. So that’s what’s in store for me within the next month.
That’s great. Are your children musical?
